I went ahead and tried it out, and it does what we agreed on. I pasted in a web address and the title and description came in on their own; I could save it, and it showed up in my library with its tags and date. Saving the same address again warned me it was already there instead of making a duplicate. Searching found the link regardless of capitalization, filtering by a tag narrowed things down, an empty search showed a clean "nothing found" state, and I was able to edit a bookmark's details and delete one cleanly. You've also confirmed my saved links survive a restart.

This is exactly the quick, low-effort way to save and manage bookmarks I wanted. I'm happy to accept it.

<FINAL_ACCEPTED>
